observations.finding: OrderService.submit has READ_COMMITTED; first database call is CustomerWriteGuard.lock(actor), before confirmation/cart reads.
CheckoutService.validate runs inside the same outer transaction; CartService.read joins it, not a separate read-only transaction.
All confirmed products are selected FOR UPDATE in ascending product ID before any DML; locked current price/status/stock/version checked.
Line and total values use positive BigDecimal, scale2 without rounding, maximum9999999999.99; total compared with server confirmation.
After product locking/repricing and immediately before first INSERT, requireCurrent rechecks same latest session/user confirmation and expiry using the existing UTC Clock.
PENDING_PAYMENT insert explicitly sets payment_method/payment_no/paid_at NULL; all immutable product and receiver snapshots are created from locked database state and normalized request shipping.
Every insert/generated identity, conditional product stock/version deduction, and exact confirmed cart deletion checks the affected row count.
Data-integrity and concurrency failures are rethrown as runtime409, not swallowed; other technical exceptions propagate to generic500. No retry or partial compensation.
Coordinator holds local session monitor across the separate transaction proxy; confirmation consumed only after successful return/commit, ended-session cleanup is tolerated after commit.
Order numbers use CSU- plus32hex from16SecureRandom bytes, length36 matching route whitelist; existing case-insensitive unique DB key is final collision guard.
Order list and count share the same bound own-user/orderNo/status WHERE; fixed creation-time/id descending order, bound LIMIT/OFFSET, no request SQL concatenation.
List orderNo is trim0..40codepoints exact equality; status ALL/5codes, size10default1..50, pageinteger<1->1; huge representational offsets yield empty pages.
Detail lookup filters orderNo and own user in SQL; malformed, unknown and foreign numbers all404; line lookup follows owned order ID without mutable product JOIN.
Order timestamps retain raw UTC LocalDateTime in model and convert only display getters to Asia/Shanghai; absent state timestamps display null.
Receiver-bearing models and validation result toString redact receiver data; no logging added; no client userId/amount/order lines determine writes.
Only user Java sources changed in backend; no schema/admin/dependency/payment/cancel/shipping endpoint modifications.
